invalid_url: That doesn't look like a web link. Check it and try again.
medium_challenge_error: Medium served an anti-bot challenge and Freedium / archive.org / archive.today all came back empty. The article may be too new to have been archived yet.
challenge_error: The site served an anti-bot challenge (Cloudflare or similar) and no usable snapshot was found on archive.org or archive.today. This site is actively blocking automated requests.
timeout_error: The website took too long to respond (30s timeout). Try again later.
connection_error: Could not connect to the website. Check the URL and try again.
unexpected_error: Unexpected error while fetching the page.
bookmarklet_hint: Drag this to your bookmarks bar. On any article you're reading in your own browser, including ones you subscribe to, click it to open that page in Reader view.
reader_empty: Couldn't find the article text on this page. Try the original page instead.
tidy_working_note: Asking the AI how this page should be laid out. It only arranges what's already here and never rewrites it. This can take a minute.
tidy_done: Tidied by {model} in {seconds}s: {headings} headings added, {joined} pieces joined, {lists} lists, {dropped} words of clutter removed. The wording is unchanged.
